subject: Post-call: Finova discovery — stakeholder map & decision criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>, Monica Reed <m.reed@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Finova discovery — stakeholder map & decision criteria

Thanks Alex + Monica — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on stakeholders and the procurement path.

Key takeaways from today's call:
- Primary use case: real-time payment authorization assistant (low-latency inference called from transaction path).
- Latency target: 95th percentile <= 200ms end-to-end for text-gen responses used in the authorization flow.
- Cost sensitivity: target unit economics that keep incremental inference cost under $0.002 per transaction (Finova expects ~1k tps peak for pilot; budget guidance in note below).
- Deployment mode: preference for Private (VPC) or Dedicated depending on SOC2 scope and KMS requirements — security will confirm.
- Decision timeline: pilot decision within ~6 weeks; legal/procurement to review pilot terms after security sign-off.

Stakeholder mapping (as I heard it):
- Economic buyer: Alex Johnson (Head of Product) — budget owner for pilot.
- Security/compliance: Monica Reed (Security Lead) — SOC2/KMS & data residency questions.
- Legal: Emily Cho (in-house counsel) — contract/redlines & IP clauses.
- Procurement: procurement@finova.com — PO/SOW and billing cadence.
- Eng/Platform: TBD (you mentioned someone from infra will join the tech demo).

Proposed next steps:
1) I will share a short pricing + pilot SOW stub (attached) for procurement to review (Marissa, today).
2) Security deep-dive: schedule 45-min technical session with Monica + our Security/Infra leads to review SOC2 evidence, KMS options, and VPC networking (Dev/Marissa to join).
3) Tech demo: 60-min demo focused on latency, routing, and canary/fallback behavior — include sample traffic profile (Dev to run).
4) Procurement/legal: loop in Emily and procurement for standard pilot terms and expected timelines.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-outline.pdf, finova-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (pricing + MAM).

If this looks right, Alex — can you confirm the infra contact and the best time window for the security deep-dive next week? We can propose times here or via Calendly.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Reed <m.reed@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com, Emily Cho <emily.cho@finova.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova discovery — stakeholder map & decision criteria

Thanks Marissa — perfect summary and thanks for the materials. Confirming a few details and adding clarifications: 

- Infra contact: Miguel Santos (miguel.santos@finova.com) — I'll loop him into the security deep-dive.
- Latency: 95p <= 200ms is what we'll need for the pilot. We also care about p99 behavior; please come prepared to discuss p99 tradeoffs with batching/kv-cache.
- Cost: ballpark budget for pilot is $18k/month (we'll need clear modeling of cost at target QPS and expected token sizes).
- Deployment: Security prefers Private (VPC) but is open to Dedicated if it simplifies compliance evidence collection.
- Timeline: aiming to sign pilot statement of work within 6 weeks as noted.

I'll ask Miguel to propose 2–3 times for the security deep-dive next week. Procurement will review the attached pricing stub but they usually want an itemized SOW + PO terms.

Alex
Head of Product | Finova Payments
alex.johnson@finova.com | +1 (212) 555-0132

From: Monica Reed <m.reed@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@finova.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova discovery — stakeholder map & decision criteria

Thanks — two immediate security items: 
1) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short summary of the encryption at rest/in-transit model (KMS options + customer-managed keys).
2) Data retention & log access: we need to confirm retention windows and whether logs/audit data can be forwarded to our SIEM (Splunk) or retained in our cloud account.

For the technical review, Miguel and I are available next Tue/Wed morning PST. Please include whoever owns KMS & networking on your side.

-Monica
Security Lead | Finova Payments

- Dev Patel (Infra/solutions): will run the demo and lead the security deep-dive.

Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova discovery — stakeholder map & decision criteria

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tue 10 Feb 2026 09:30 PST (calendar invite sent). A couple of quick follow-ups before the session:

1) Attachment: updated pricing outline and an itemized pilot SOW (redwood-pricing-outline.pdf attached). This includes: expected resource profile for a 1k tps pilot, preliminary cost modeling, and a 3-month pilot discount option.
2) For the security session, Dev will bring: SOC2 summary, KMS options (including CMK flow), network diagram for VPC peering, and audit/log export options (Splunk vs S3).
3) Procurement — please let us know if you need a formal vendor questionnaire before the session; Happy to provide our security questionnaire or complete Finova's.

Next steps after Tue's session: if security is satisfied we will move to an itemized SOW + PO. Marissa will coordinate final SOW for your procurement.

Appreciate the quick turn — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
